correctness.rationale: C PASS: The stated exact model is a genuine parameter specialization of equation (2.2) of Al Amri–Khan–Greenhalgh, including positive incidence and predation parameters. The positive ecological equilibrium is unique; Jacobian trace and determinant cross a nondegenerate Hopf boundary. Canonical-coordinate derivative reconstruction gives l1=-f0/4<0; the Hopf normal form yields Var(x)=2d0*epsilon+o(epsilon). Period averages of log(z) and log(x) yield the exact prey mean and signed predator coefficient. Rational substitution gives both exact opposite coefficients at the same alpha. The transverse scalar infection equation gives the exponent difference, with a positive death-rate interval. The saved verify.py symbolically and numerically checks the central identities.

Bate and Hilker already prove general oscillatory invasion threshold averaging and describe example reversals, so those general phenomena are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The new result is the exact signed coefficient for the saturating fear–Allee system and two opposite rational signs obtained by varying only the habituation floor. Closest public mathematical records concern different systems and do not imply these coefficients. Priority remains subject to unindexed equivalents and a related 2019 fear paper not verified in full.

value.rationale: V PASS: A common ecological question is whether environmental oscillations protect or expose prey populations to parasite invasion. The initiating paper independently studies fear and infection; the exact calculation connects them quantitatively. It identifies a non-obvious mechanism—predator mean bias, despite exactly unchanged mean susceptible prey—that reverses a practical local invasion test under one biologically interpretable fear parameter. This is an exact structural threshold phenomenon, not a generic rephrasing of averaging.
